system.description:
Range and duration as the spell copied.

  • Weave shadow into a copy of one Evocation or Conjuration spell you have seen cast within the last minute, by anyone, of a level no higher than the highest spell level you can cast.
  • It has the copied spell's full effect, but every save it calls for is a Will save; a creature that succeeds sees the shadow for what it is, takes half damage and ignores the spell's other effects.
  • A copied spell that calls for no save gives each creature it affects one Will save to halve its damage.
  • A shadow creature's or object's attacks count as the spell's.

Classes: Wizard, Illusionist, Bard
system.range: Range and duration as the spell copied
system.saveEffect: Sees through it and is unaffected
